Ill. * Full text * Red and blue only * Red only

   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Ill.]
Tongue covered with aphthæ ; most on edges.
Edges of tongue folded like little bags.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Ill.]
Tough, viscid phlegm from stomach ; with old drunkards.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Ill.]
Three months' colic, especially if it recurs at regular hours ; bowels disturbed.
Violent wind colic.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Ill.]
Dyspnœa in old asthmatics.
   

COUGH. [27] [Ill.]
Frequent cough, with pain.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Ill.]
Tough, viscous phlegm, with old drunkards.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Ill.]
Palpitation, with aphthæ and weakness.
